description: This file implements a SignIn page component for a gym management front-end application. It provides email/password login via Supabase and includes OAuth options for Google and GitHub. It manages user authentication flow, navigation, and renders relevant form and branding components.

classes.name: SignIn
classes.description: React functional component implementing the SignIn page with OAuth and email/password login.

methods.name: handleEmailPassword
methods.description: Handles form submission for email/password login, performs sign-in and redirects based on user role.
